title: Why the Wheel Strategy Fails on SPY
text: First, the wheel itself is not a strategy. It's just a series of trades. In this context, trading the wheel in something like spy, you're just trading the market tending to go up, maybe some other factors depending on what you overlay. So first, if we look at how the position starts, it's via a cash secured put. The first issue you'll notice is that that is a capped upside profit potential position. It means you you do not enjoy unlimited upside profit, but you have unlimited downside risk. That's not inherently good or bad by itself, but if we think what this means in the context of spy, the fact that it tends to go up, yet we've capped our upside on the initial leg.
